image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a substrate of small, light-colored gravel and pebbles. The salamander features a glossy black body with vivid, irregular yellow patches covering its head, back, and limbs. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad, and the eyes are dark and prominent. The forelimbs and part of the hindlimbs are visible, showing short, stout digits.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly broad and flattened relative to the neck. The area behind the eyes shows the characteristic swelling associated with parotoid glands, consistent with the species' anatomy.
